steps.en: Download the sd binary for your backend from Releases, or build it with CMake
steps.zh: 从 Releases 下载对应后端的 sd 二进制，或用 CMake 编译

steps.en: Generate an image with one command
Detects the model family, loads the weights and quantizes them on load if you asked
steps.zh: 识别模型家族，加载权重，按需在加载时量化

steps.en: Runs text encoder, sampler and VAE on the ggml backend, spilling weights to RAM when VRAM is short
steps.zh: 在 ggml 后端上跑文本编码、采样和 VAE，显存不够时把权重挪到内存

steps.en: Writes the PNG with generation parameters embedded, WebUI-style
steps.zh: 写出 PNG，并按 WebUI 格式嵌入生成参数

value.en: Diffusion on your own CPU/GPU from one native binary — no Python or PyTorch environment to keep in step with your drivers
value.zh: 一个原生二进制就能在自己的 CPU/GPU 上跑扩散模型，不用维护与驱动对齐的 Python/PyTorch 环境

sources: https://github.com/leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp README Quick Start (releases page / build guide; weight formats; ./bin/sd-cli -m ../models/v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors -p "a lovely cat")
README Features (ckpt/safetensors/GGUF; webui-compatible parameter string embedded in PNG output)
docs/build.md (patched ggml submodule vs SD_USE_UPSTREAM_GGML), docs/quantization_and_gguf.md (--type quantizes on load)
docs/performance.md (--offload-to-cpu, --params-backend, automatic segmented execution when VRAM is short)
